Claude Skills, explained. For a small business.
Priya runs a sweet shop. Every week, she types thirty invoices by hand.
A Claude Skill is your instructions, saved once. Your template, your rules. Claude uses it whenever that job comes up.
Priya's week. Thirty invoices, twelve minutes each. That's six hours.
One year later, that's over three hundred hours. Almost forty working days, just typing.
Now meet a second Priya. She teaches Claude her invoice format. Just once.
So, how long does her week take now?
About one hour. Claude drafts. She checks, and sends.
Her Skill holds the boring part. The template, the tax rates, her customers. She sets it up once, and it pays back in the first week.
To be fair, AI can make mistakes. She still checks every total before it goes out.
And it's not just invoices. Payment reminders. Supplier orders. Monthly sales summaries.
Teach it once. Save every week.
